segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex from independent Tibetan-first and English-first proposals; no human semantic acceptance. HGM25644 (glossary, HTG2016) attests the complete living-world expression world, in the form of those who live in it; supplied initial The is excluded and sems can is not falsely isolated as those who live in it. Its unique 'jig rten/world member is retained. rang gi sems/their minds is a contextual possessive compound: HGM18356 is auto-aligned own mind, not an exact glossary-tier equivalent; rang gi locally licenses their and sems/minds is its tighter member. The later explanatory minds after bad thoughts has no separate source mind. bdag gi dngos po/its very being is a contextual complete d3 phrase; HGM9065's auto-aligned through the power is preserved as contrary evidence, not promoted. HGM11071 (glossary, HTG2016) supports the environmental-world unit places where these beings live with the tighter snod/places member; the earlier expanded worlds token stays unpaired to avoid banking the same unit twice. The complete sems can de dag kho na'i phrase owns these same beings, and no one else. HGM20684 (glossary, HTG2016) expressly attests sems nyid/their own minds; this is not a generic sems equivalent. No exact HGM thun mang ba'i las entry exists: retain only its las/karma and omit the disputed spelling thun mang ba. The LOW/PROBABLE proposed THUN MONG spelling is editorial review only, supported by the bounded ILL continuation and local common-karma constructions; recorded source remains THUN MANG. Second bsags pa and the third explanatory English karma remain unpaired as distributed/repeated rendering, not null. The great-disc-of-wind compound has distinct wind and disc members; Below No Other is an attested name. The complete final environmental-bound phrase owns farthest reaches of the world. Supplied cosmographic explanation, participants, articles and auxiliary frames remain unwrapped. All source text stays verbatim.
